run_clean_conll: run the clean_conll_file script to preprocess a CoNLL file and filter long or malformed lines
run_clean_conll_with_model: run the clean_conll_file script with a custom tokenizer model and max length for preprocessing
run_clean_conll_stdout: run the clean_conll_file script to output cleaned CoNLL lines to stdout after filtering
review_main_function: review the main function that tokenizes CoNLL lines and enforces a maximum subword length limit
refactor_main_function: refactor the main function to write cleaned CoNLL output to a file instead of stdout
